description: This file defines a custom exception class `MigrationException` used within the OrangeHRM installer module, specifically for handling migration-related errors. The class extends the built-in PHP `Exception` class and provides a static method to generate an exception when a previous migration is incomplete.

classes.name: MigrationException
classes.description: A custom exception class for migration process errors within the installer module of OrangeHRM. It includes a static method to instantiate the exception with a specific message indicating an incomplete previous migration.

methods.name: previousMigrationIncomplete
methods.description: Static factory method that creates a new instance of `MigrationException` with a message indicating that the previous migration was incomplete.

calls: new self('The previous migration is incomplete.')
